fusions.name: Textbook Opening
fusions.desc: You step in on a target up to 3 tiles away and thrust, which deals 30 piercing damage and always lands as a critical hit. The target is 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Drilled Pair
fusions.desc: Thrusts both tines out together, each dealing 6 piercing damage to the first enemy it meets within 4 tiles. Your critical chance is 40% higher against a target that has not yet been wounded. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Run the Form Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and steps you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Second Tine
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
